svg.text: Bench hook-ups. Red wire = plus, black wire = minus. The board is seen from the front.
A Two ways to make the 1.8 V feed
Option A: a 1.8 V regulator or bench supply
Option B: two AA cells and two resistors
Measure PLUS feed to MINUS feed before the adapter is connected:
1.70 to 1.95 V. Never feed the adapter from 3.3 V, 5 V or 9 V.
PLUS feed to the 1V8 opening, MINUS feed to the GND opening.
The two feed wires swapped: PLUS to the GND opening,
D Reversed, with the ground link (Part 3)
As C, plus 1 kohm from the GND test hole to the MINUS feed.
The meter reads the voltage across that resistor.
E Loop test with the HS3 (Part 4)
Feed the right way round. One loop wire from the TDO opening
to TDI, then to TMS, then to TCK.
• The adapter is NOT on the FPGA card for any of this.
• Feed voltage 1.70 to 1.95 V. Check it with the meter first.
• Keep the 100 ohm resistor in the plus lead (it is part of
option B). It limits every mistake to a few milliamps.
• Change wires only with the feed disconnected.
• Jumper pins: the ordinary 0.64 mm square or thin round
kind. Nothing thicker goes into the socket.
• Meter on volts or ohms. Never put the probes across the
feed with the red lead in the meter's A or mA socket.
• Order of the socket openings, seen from the front:
GND TDI TDO TCK TMS 1V8 (cut-off corner at 1V8).
